spec.books: me = month-end decisions; mid15 = first session on/after the 15th of each month; both on one calendar, one rank cache

honest: the screen repairs arithmetic impossibility only; a flagged ETF print may be genuine, so 'neutralise' is a sensitivity face, not a corrected truth
drop mode changes the universe size, so its delta mixes the correction with a composition change and its eligibility set differs from the twin
the churn sleeve is an equal-weight mean over the swapped names, not a portfolio return: it prices whether the names taken in beat the names given up inside that window
the turnover column is the control that the screen moves the return path and not the traded book; a screened turnover that differs from its twin means the screen changed eligibility, not the calendar
gapped prints are never repaired, so a churn carried by a behind-suspension print reads flat here rather than corrected
descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no prereg, no trial booking
